capabilities: Insert goal metadata strips under headings
Roll up goals by folder into parent dashboards
Save and restore dashboard views and configurations
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.15.1 or later (desktop only). Self-contained with no QuickAdd or Dataview dependency. Goal strips remain in Markdown notes after uninstall; data.json holds configurations, saved views, and assignments.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to structure goals with metadata, track their dependencies, or roll them up into filtered dashboards.
summary: Goal-tracking plugin that adds metadata strips under headings, tracks dependencies and ratings, and builds filterable dashboards with folder rollups.
